description: Go 1.26+ high-performance AI proxy gateway refactored from 9router (Next.js)

phases.name: Maintenance Mode (perpetual sentinel)
phases.description: Not a development phase. Sentinel state (-1) that activates when no pending dev phase exists or when manually triggered. Never marked done.
phases.trigger: auto when current_phase has no pending target, or manual invocation
tasks: Check GitHub Issues for bug reports or feature requests
Run go build ./... && go test ./... to verify project health
Review and merge dependabot PRs if safe
Fix reported issues and push patches (tag v1.0.x or v1.N.x)
Upstream sync: compare upstream_commits hashes, port relevant changes
Scan 9router open issues + merged PRs for applicable fixes (record in upstream_ports)
Check 9router open-sse/providers/registry/ for new providers or baseUrl changes
If no action needed: report 'no pending work' and exit

phases.name: Core Infrastructure & Database Layer
phases.summary: Project layout (cmd/gateway + internal/), SQLite via modernc.org/sqlite, settings repo, KV store, graceful shutdown, slog JSON logging.

phases.name: Provider & Connection Management
phases.summary: Provider nodes repo, account fallback (cooldown + exponential backoff + model locks), priority-based credential selection, connection status, provider CRUD.

phases.name: Model Resolution & Combos
phases.summary: Model string parsing, alias resolution, combo system (fallback + round-robin + sticky limit), model availability, combo CRUD, unit tests.

phases.name: OpenAI-Compatible API Surface
phases.summary: /v1/chat/completions + /v1/messages + /v1/models + /v1/embeddings, middleware chain, SSE streaming proxy (disconnect-aware), format translation (OpenAI/Claude/Gemini), usage extraction, integration tests.

phases.name: Dashboard Panel System
phases.summary: CLI params + env vars, embedded single-HTML dashboard (go:embed), panel serving (local dir > downloaded cache > embedded), runtime panel download with dist.zip support.

phases.name: Authentication & API Keys
phases.summary: HMAC-signed API key generation/validation, Bearer middleware for /v1/*, cookie-based dashboard session auth, login/logout, requireApiKey enforcement.

phases.name: Usage Tracking & Observability
phases.summary: Usage history repo, token extraction (stream + non-stream), daily aggregation, request details logging, /api/usage/* endpoints.

phases.name: Dashboard Management API
phases.summary: Full REST API: providers CRUD, provider-nodes CRUD, combos update, proxy-pools CRUD, enhanced /api/health.

phases.name: Advanced Features & Enhancements
phases.summary: OAuth token refresh (pre-check + on-401 retry), loop guard (VansRouter), termination prompt injection, proxy pool rotation, provider test endpoint, max_tokens clamping (NVIDIA Kimi).

phases.name: Provider Registry Expansion & Categorization
phases.summary: Full 9router registry port: 64 apikey + 16 oauth + 13 freeTier + 5 free + 2 webCookie providers, category/authModes metadata, grouped /api/registry, registry completeness tests.

phases.name: Provider Detail Management
phases.summary: Per-provider detail: connection test with latency, credential editing, custom models (KV providerModels scope), /api/providers/{id}/models, cooldown/error display.

phases.name: OAuth Authorization Flow
phases.summary: Authorize URL (PKCE), callback code exchange, device code flow (qwen/kimi), manual token import (codex/cursor/kiro), panel OAuth modals, token refresh wired into chat path with dedup lock.

phases.name: Quota Tracker & Token Saver
phases.summary: Per-connection quota limits + usage tracking, quota-aware fallback selection, /api/quota, panel quota page, RTK caveman/ponytail compression in request path.

phases.name: Tunnel & Tailscale
phases.summary: Tailscale detection/install/enable/disable endpoints, /api/tunnel/status, panel tunnel page, graceful degradation.

phases.name: WebUI Engineering Foundation
phases.summary: Single-HTML → Vue 3.5 + Vite + TS + Pinia + hash router, design tokens (dark/light), component library, SPA layout, typed API client, go:embed dist pipeline, CI webui build step.

phases.summary: 118 brand logos, card grid by category, connection status badges, search, Test All (parallel, 10-concurrency), full-page provider detail, Add Provider modal (Registry/OpenAI/Anthropic tabs), OAuth connect modals.

phases.name: Media Providers

phases.name: CLI Tools Integration
